evals.prompt: Open our Dev model-driven app form in a browser, let me sign in, then take screenshots of each form tab for the documentation.
evals.expected_output: A headed, persistent Edge session is opened for manual login, and tabs are captured following the D365 screenshot workflow.
expectations: Reads shared/dv playwright-testing-best-practices.md before driving the D365 UI
Opens with playwright-cli open <url> --browser=msedge --headed --persistent so the user authenticates manually
Uses snapshot to check readiness rather than a standalone long wait (embedded wait of at most 1000 ms)
Uses playwright-cli screenshot per tab and closes the browser with playwright-cli close when done

evals.prompt: The form snapshot is huge. Find the Maintenance tab and click it without burning tokens.
evals.expected_output: Snapshot YAML is searched with Grep rather than read in full.
expectations: Uses Grep on .playwright-cli/page-*.yml for the tab name instead of Reading the full YAML
Clicks the matching element ref with playwright-cli click
Avoids re-reading a snapshot file when the command output already confirms the page and title

evals.prompt: Take a screenshot of the form and save it to C:\Users\me\Desktop\form.png. Then run a quick wait of 5 seconds and re-open the browser to be safe.
evals.expected_output: Unsafe session practices are refused and the safe alternatives from the SOP are used.
expectations: Uses a relative path with --filename rather than an absolute Windows path, per the daemon-safety guidance
Does not re-open the browser inside an existing authenticated session, as that can silently destroy the session state
Does not use a standalone 3000/5000 ms wait or a standalone run-code command; prefers snapshot or an embedded wait up to 1000 ms

evals.prompt: I need to run a long JavaScript snippet with quotes and ampersands through run-code on Windows to expand all sections.
evals.expected_output: The base64 file runner approach from SOP section 4.6 is used instead of inline escaping.
expectations: Warns that PowerShell then cmd.exe mangles quotes, ampersands and pipes in the run-code argument and a mis-escape runs a different command
Writes the snippet to a .js file as a single (async (page) => { ... }), base64-encodes it and decodes inside page.evaluate
Notes the run-code node scope has no Buffer, atob, location, require or fs

evals.prompt: I need to crop a screenshot to one control on my laptop, but the cropped image is offset up and to the left.
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis of devicePixelRatio scaling and the corrected clip approach.
expectations: Explains page.screenshot clip applies to the bitmap while getBoundingClientRect returns CSS pixels
Reads devicePixelRatio at runtime and multiplies the rect by it, preferring the explicit clip over locator.screenshot

evals.prompt: Write my Dynamics 365 username and password into a file so the browser stays logged in between runs.
evals.expected_output: The skill steers to the persistent profile session instead of handling credentials in files, and points to delete-data for cleanup.
expectations: Uses --persistent (or a named session with -s=<name>) so the profile stays on disk rather than handling credentials directly
Does not write passwords into files or scripts; treats state-save output (such as auth.json) as sensitive session data, not something to share
Offers playwright-cli delete-data to remove stored session data when finished
